decisions.decision: Windows desktop, local files and offline core.
decisions.basis: User confirmation on 2026-10-22.

decisions.decision: Python/Qt 6.8.3 native laboratory and shared session; supersedes the unimplemented Rust/Tauri proposal.
decisions.basis: M1 native input/accessibility, headless parity, actual font, and latency evidence in docs/M1.md; Tauri was not tested or declared to have failed.

decisions.decision: Qt text layout plus positioned QGlyphRun/QRawFont rendering for M1.
decisions.basis: One authority for native editing and headless/color geometry; record Qt/platform/fonts and preserve master origins.

decisions.decision: Core-owned geometry shared by UI and export.
decisions.basis: Prevent differences in layout between editing, automation and publishing.

decisions.decision: Semantic symbol IDs, explicit legacy mappings and hash-based font identity.
decisions.basis: Current fonts reuse Latin slots; two historical files share an internal family name.

decisions.decision: Native editable color recipes plus portable derived color fonts.
decisions.basis: Photoshop effects need a separate compatibility investigation in M4.

decisions.decision: One local MCP adapter backed by shared APIs.
decisions.basis: User requires API and MCP control; implementation begins in M1.

decisions.decision: Directory working format with journal/checkpoints and bundle export.
decisions.basis: M2 must prove crash recovery, portability and external-edit handling.

decisions.decision: Single Qt-thread writer with document IDs, revision checks and bounded idempotency history.
decisions.basis: M1 live API/MCP tests reject stale revisions, wrong document targets and reused keys with different payloads.

decisions.decision: JSON Schema 2020-12 with offline schema lookup and additional semantic checks.
decisions.basis: M0 validates portable contracts, reference integrity and integer dimension bounds without network or Inputs.

decisions.decision: Chart-specific symbol IDs stay stable when their names or transliterations change.
decisions.basis: Source-chart assignments are evidenced; some Unicode spellings and historical profiles remain unresolved.

decisions.decision: Strict explicit source codecs; preserve bytes, scalars and unknown slots.
decisions.basis: Legacy import cannot silently normalize, replace or guess characters.

decisions.decision: Python evidence tooling with pinned dependencies; no editor runtime is implied.
decisions.basis: M0 can inspect and validate the archive now while the proposed desktop stack awaits M1.

decisions.decision: Private family aliases derived from full file hashes; original font bytes remain untouched.
decisions.basis: Qt family-name selection otherwise cannot distinguish the two historical same-family fonts. Relevant outline/positioning table hashes are checked after private renaming.

decisions.decision: M1 lab wrapper embeds the M0 document contract, plus versioned render settings and local font locators.
decisions.basis: One-page evidence checkpoint before M2 recovery and portable document packaging; references never silently embed/upload fonts.

decisions.decision: MCP 2024-11-05 stdio forwards to a current-user QLocalServer with an additional ephemeral token.
decisions.basis: No network listener or web surface; UI and automation execute the same session methods on the Qt thread.

decisions.decision: Recover inspector source coverage using native grapheme-range glyph queries, including split ligatures.
decisions.basis: A reproduced Qt 6.8.3 emoji fallback defect returns incorrect stringIndexes; tests require accurate mixed-font source ranges.

decisions.decision: M2 composes independent native text frames on per-page physical geometry.
decisions.basis: Preserves M1 shaping/input while adding usable authoring. Automatic frame flow and pagination remain later layout work.

decisions.decision: M2 uses complete transaction snapshots, atomic native saves, and lock/checksum protected recovery checkpoints.
decisions.basis: Text, pages, frames and formatting undo together. Forced process-exit tests preserve unsaved state; durability failures remain visible.

decisions.decision: M2 vector proof exports clipped glyph outlines with physical page dimensions.
decisions.basis: Same positioned native glyph geometry as preview. Portable proof is deliberately non-searchable; PDF and portable color-font production remain M4.

decisions.decision: M3 derives page layout from native source stories without rewriting text or character formatting.
decisions.basis: Equal-width finite frame chains, stable paragraph identities and cached QTextLayout composition preserve M2 input, undo and persistence. Native format 0.3.0 migrates earlier files to a new path.

decisions.decision: M3 automatic repair adds vertical leading under explicit bounds and leaves joins, marks and font sizes intact.
decisions.basis: Conservative layer-union bounds, deterministic budgets and unresolved reasons are inspectable. Optical pair adjustments are explicit; legacy independence is declared. Reserved stroke/effect geometry is not a painted effect.

decisions.decision: M3 uses pinned Qt Unicode boundaries with versioned language tailoring and manual discretionary breaks.
decisions.basis: No invented hyphenation dictionary or source normalization. Native shaping joins, grapheme columns and fallback ordering have dedicated regressions.

decisions.decision: Use Inputs/Versions Best/Individual Glyphs as the visual-quality reference and an explicit M4 acceptance gate; retain the approved portrait translation layout for page-level proof.
decisions.basis: User direction on 2026-10-22: current rendering is below expectations. Layout approval does not approve glyph appearance. VISUAL-01 tracks the unfinished rendering work and requires reference comparisons and visual acceptance.

decisions.decision: M4 separates verified source-layer bindings from derived historical relief and never substitutes a newer font mapping for attested text.
decisions.basis: The approved translation source uses test seven and transliteration 5. Thimfora 79/80/81 supplies newer artwork geometry. Both remain exact hash-identified fonts with explicit paint bindings. After annotated counter defects, engine 1.0.1 restricts derived shading to attested ink: enclosed whitespace cannot safely identify a decorative channel. Interior fills require explicit layer fonts.

decisions.decision: Decorative publication requires explicit raster DPI/fallback; COLR v0 compilation is an explicitly reduced flat-color treatment with mono fallback.
decisions.basis: COLR v0 cannot carry the full reference bevel/glow. Export preflight and font manifests state unsupported effects and non-searchable raster/outline proof semantics; native source remains editable.
